Profile a DBTable_v9

Source: R/profile.R
profile_table.Rd

Profiles every row of a DBTable_v9 with profile_query(). The table supplies the query, the field types and the keys.

Usage

profile_table(table, columns = NULL, ...)

Arguments

table

A DBTable_v9.

columns

The sensitivity of each column, as in profile_query().

...

Other arguments to profile_query(). Do not give connection, sql, field_types or keys.

Value

A csdb_profile, as profile_query() returns it. The query is dbplyr::sql_render(table$tbl()).

See also

Other profile functions: profile_data(), profile_query(), read_profile(), write_profile()

Examples

tab <- DBTable_v9$new(
  dbconfig = list(driver = "SQLite", db = tempfile(fileext = ".sqlite")),
  table_name = "visits",
  field_types = c(id = "INTEGER", sex = "TEXT"),
  keys = "id",
  validator_field_types = validator_field_types_blank,
  validator_field_contents = validator_field_contents_blank
)
tab$create_table()
#> Creating table visits
#> NULL
tab$insert_data(data.table::data.table(
  id = 1:12,
  sex = rep(c("female", "male"), 6)
))
p <- profile_table(tab, columns = c(sex = "full"))
p$columns$sex
#> $type
#> [1] "TEXT"
#> 
#> $sensitivity
#> [1] "full"
#> 
#> $missing_share
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $levels
#> [1] "female" "male"  
#> 
#> $n
#> [1] 6 6
#> 
tab$dbconnection$disconnect()
